text: Implemented visible BorrowedNDArray ownership, JVM/JS copy and unsafeBorrow interop, dtype-specific JS descriptors, explicit equality and bounded previews, reusable laws artifact, real Chromium plus Node suites, NumPy/ownership/release documentation, resolved OPEN-003 budgets, and a copy-only gale-interop-ravel cross-project in ../gale. Canonical Ravel testAllFull and representationProof passed; Gale interopRavelTest passed 4 JVM and 4 Scala.js tests. A JVM benchmark caught an oversized interpreted dispatcher; splitting dispatch into small monomorphic dtype methods improved public 65,536-element addition from ~86 to 6,748 ops/s.
